- Surface relation: indirect; 1:1 `بِسْمِ`, 1:2 `ٱلْحَمْدُ ... رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ`, 1:4 `ٱلدِّينِ`, 1:5 `نَسْتَعِينُ`, 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ`, and 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ ... غَيْرِ`.
- Surprising reach: The field moves from a city defined by obedience into a camp secured by stored water, then upward to layered clouds, persistent rain, gentle wind, and enduring plants.

#### Subchannel A. Governed and Pleasant Settlement
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A community establishes residence in a governed place, finds the site suitable, and remains there.
- Active motifs: city as the place where authority is obeyed `د ي ن:B006/m01`; residence or settled place `ق و م:B006/m01`; the village or locality of Anah `ع و ن:B008/m01`; a place pleasant for settlement `ن ع م:B011/m01`; finding a person or place satisfactory `ح م د:B002/m01`; continued residence `ر ب ب:B007/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:2 `ٱلْحَمْدُ` and `رَبِّ` (`ح م د`, `ر ب ب`); 1:4 `ٱلدِّينِ` (`د ي ن`); 1:5 `نَسْتَعِينُ` (`ع و ن`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ` (`ن ع م`)
- Synthesis: Authority gives the settlement civic form, residence supplies continuity, and suitability supplies the inhabitants' positive judgment of the place. The named locality makes the scene geographically concrete.

#### Subchannel B. Water-Secured Encampment and Livelihood
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A community locates abundant collected water, controls its encampment through that resource, and sustains livelihood by storing and distributing it.
- Active motifs: abundant fresh water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; sea or water-rich well `ع ل م:B005/m01`; water that secures command of camp and livelihood `م ل ك:B007/m01`; sustenance of life `ق و م:B009/m02`; irrigation of land and people `غ ي ر:B001/m02`
- Ayah anchors: 1:2 `رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ` (`ر ب ب`, `ع ل م`); 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ` (`م ل ك`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `غَيْرِ` (`غ ي ر`)
- Synthesis: The well or collected water supplies the resource, control of water makes encampment possible, irrigation extends it into the surrounding land, and livelihood is the resulting stable state.

#### Subchannel C. Sky, Rain, Wind, and Enduring Growth
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: The overhead sky forms layered rainclouds, weather persists, a gentle southern wind moves through, and watered vegetation remains green.
- Active motifs: overhead sky `س م و:B004/m01`; cloud and rain `س م و:B004/m02`; layered raincloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; persistent cloud or wind `ر ب ب:B007/m02`; gentle south wind `ن ع م:B009/m01`; enduring green plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; old established palm `ع و ن:B004/m01`; irrigation `غ ي ر:B001/m02`
- Ayah anchors: 1:1 `بِسْمِ` (`س م و`); 1:2 `رَبِّ` (`ر ب ب`); 1:5 `نَسْتَعِينُ` (`ع و ن`); 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ` and `غَيْرِ` (`ن ع م`, `غ ي ر`)
- Synthesis: Layered cloud gathers the water-bearing material, persistence and wind describe weather movement, irrigation delivers water to the ground, and green plant and old palm display growth across both season and duration.

### 10. Structural Support and Working Materials
- Semantic invariant: Stability is produced by cohesive material, load-bearing members, mechanical parts, and treatments that bind, coat, or repair.
- Surface relation: indirect; 1:2 `رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ`, 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ`, 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ`, 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ`, and 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ ... غَيْرِ`.
- Surprising reach: Abstract mainstay and firmness resolve into wall cohesion, knots, table or well parts, kneaded material, thick concentrate, and coated transport surfaces.

#### Subchannel A. Cohesion, Mainstay, and Upright Members
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A structure or undertaking remains standing because material cohesion, a firm joint, and upright supporting members carry its load.
- Active motifs: material cohesion and strength `م ل ك:B001/m01`; mainstay of an affair `م ل ك:B005/m01`; structural support `ق و م:B009/m01`; upright tool or furniture member `ق و م:B012/m01`; firm knot or joint `ر ب ب:B016/m02`; strength and solidity `ع ب د:B007/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:2 `رَبِّ` (`ر ب ب`); 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ` (`م ل ك`); 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`)
- Synthesis: Cohesion binds the material, the knot or joint fixes connected parts, upright members transfer load, and the mainstay names the same sustaining function at the scale of an entire undertaking.

#### Subchannel B. Well and Water-Lifting Assembly
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: An upright timber and working components are arranged over a water source so a settlement can draw and control water.
- Active motifs: ostrich-shaped well timber `ن ع م:B007/m01`; upright mechanical component `ق و م:B012/m01`; water-rich well `ع ل م:B005/m01`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; water securing the camp `م ل ك:B007/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:2 `رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ` (`ر ب ب`, `ع ل م`); 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ` (`م ل ك`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ` (`ن ع م`)
- Synthesis: The well supplies the setting and resource, the upright timber and associated standing part supply the mechanism, and control of the lifted water supplies the functional outcome.

#### Subchannel C. Thickening, Coating, and Repair
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A thick material is worked to cohesion, applied as a coating or preservative, and used to repair containers, food, medicine, or transport surfaces.
- Active motifs: thick syrup or oily residue `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; repair or preservation with that concentrate `ر ب ب:B006/m02`; kneading into cohesion `م ل ك:B001/m02`; tarred or coated vessel, ship, or animal `ع ب د:B005/m02`; repair of travel gear `غ ي ر:B001/m03`; softened material or food `ن ع م:B002/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:2 `رَبِّ` (`ر ب ب`); 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ` (`م ل ك`); 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:7 `غَيْرِ` and `أَنْعَمْتَ` (`غ ي ر`, `ن ع م`)
- Synthesis: Kneading and concentration produce workable consistency, coating applies the material to a surface, and repair or preservation supplies the outcome. Softness and cohesion are complementary target states rather than opposing qualities.

### 11. Bodily Integrity, Posture, and Injury
- Semantic invariant: A living body is read through stance, proportion, strength, visible markers, pain, and loss of function.
- Surface relation: indirect; 1:1 and 1:3 `ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ` / `ٱلرَّحِيمِ`, 1:2 `ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ`, 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ`, 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ ... نَسْتَعِينُ`, 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ`, and 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ ... ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ`.
- Surprising reach: Uprightness and firmness describe healthy stature, yet the same standing field also holds an intact-looking blind eye, diseased legs, swollen tissue, and a body halted by weakness.

#### Subchannel A. Upright Stature and Balanced Strength
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A body rises upright, displays proportion and firmness, and sustains its posture through balanced mature strength.
- Active motifs: bodily rising and upright stance `ق و م:B002/m01`; stature and bodily proportion `ق و م:B011/m01`; strength and solidity `ع ب د:B007/m01`; balanced mature build `ع و ن:B005/m01`; bodily cohesion `م ل ك:B001/m01`; thick, strongly colored body `غ ض ب:B005/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ` (`م ل ك`); 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` and `نَسْتَعِينُ` (`ع ب د`, `ع و ن`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ` (`غ ض ب`)
- Synthesis: Rising supplies posture, stature supplies visible proportion, and cohesion, solidity, and mature balance supply the forces that maintain it. Thickness and strong coloration render bodily vigor externally perceptible.

#### Subchannel B. Lesion, Swelling, and Localized Pain
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A specific body part bears a visible lesion or swelling and becomes the site of persistent pain.
- Active motifs: cleft in the upper lip `ع ل م:B004/m01`; swelling around the eye `غ ض ب:B006/m01`; pain lodged in an organ `ق و م:B019/m01`; postpartum uterine pain `ر ح م:B004/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:1 and 1:3 `ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ` / `ٱلرَّحِيمِ` (`ر ح م`); 1:2 `ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ` (`ع ل م`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ` (`غ ض ب`)
- Synthesis: Cleft and swelling provide visible signs, while localized pain provides the felt state. The postpartum uterus extends the same diagnostic scene to an internal reproductive organ.

#### Subchannel C. Preserved Appearance with Failed Function
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A body or limb remains visibly present yet fails in sight, gait, strength, or forward movement.
- Active motifs: intact-looking eye without sight `ق و م:B021/m01`; disease in a sheep's legs `ق و م:B020/m01`; dull, weak, heavy person `ه د ي:B009/m01`; exhausted mount unable to continue `ع ب د:B011/m01`; eye delight and visual refreshment `ن ع م:B013/m01`; eye swelling `غ ض ب:B006/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:6 `ٱهْدِنَا` and `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ه د ي`, `ق و م`); 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ` and `ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ` (`ن ع م`, `غ ض ب`)
- Synthesis: The blind but intact eye most clearly separates appearance from operation. Diseased legs, bodily heaviness, and an exhausted mount repeat that separation in movement, while eye delight supplies the contrasting state of restored visual ease.

#### Subchannel D. Bodily Markers of Maturity and Reproduction
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: Bodily marks, sexual maturity, reproductive capacity, and age make a living body classifiable.
- Active motifs: pubic hair `ع و ن:B007/m01`; womb as reproductive organ `ر ح م:B003/m01`; middle age `ع و ن:B002/m01`; mature balanced strength `ع و ن:B005/m01`; a distinguishing bodily mark `ع ل م:B002/m03`
- Ayah anchors: 1:1 and 1:3 `ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ` / `ٱلرَّحِيمِ` (`ر ح م`); 1:2 `ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ` (`ع ل م`); 1:5 `نَسْتَعِينُ` (`ع و ن`)
- Synthesis: Visible hair and marks supply external indicators, the womb supplies reproductive capacity, and age with mature strength locates the body within a life stage. Classification emerges from the conjunction of form, function, and development.

### 12. Conflict, Anger, and Defensive Order
- Semantic invariant: Opposition escalates through rivalry and anger into combat, retaliation, defense, defeat, or compensatory settlement.
- Surface relation: direct; 1:2 `ٱلْحَمْدُ`, 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ ... نَسْتَعِينُ`, 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ`, and 1:7 `غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ ... ٱلضَّآلِّينَ`.
- Surprising reach: Competitive striving becomes repeated war and mutual resistance, while anger over loss can terminate either in vengeance or in indemnity; hardness also becomes literal defensive material.

#### Subchannel A. Rivalry, Resistance, and Repeated War
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: Competitors seek superiority, rise against one another, and turn repeated opposition into organized combat.
- Active motifs: rivalry and competitive matching `س م و:B007/m01`; war fought repeatedly `ع و ن:B003/m01`; mutual resistance and combat `ق و م:B014/m01`; defiance and opposition `غ ض ب:B003/m01`; resolve and rising to action `ق و م:B003/m01`; the publicly praised champion `ح م د:B003/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:1 `بِسْمِ` (`س م و`); 1:2 `ٱلْحَمْدُ` (`ح م د`); 1:5 `نَسْتَعِينُ` (`ع و ن`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ` (`غ ض ب`)
- Synthesis: Competition supplies the initiating comparison, resolve converts comparison into action, resistance supplies reciprocal force, and repeated war stabilizes opposition as an enduring social frame. Praise records the reputation won within that contest.

#### Subchannel B. Anger, Mourning, Vengeance, and Redress
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Injury or loss provokes anger and grief, which can seek retaliatory vengeance or be redirected into compensatory settlement.
- Active motifs: intense anger `غ ض ب:B001/m01`; retaliatory wrath `غ ض ب:B001/m02`; pride and hot resentment `ع ب د:B008/m01`; grief and regret after loss `ع ب د:B008/m02`; anger for the living or mourning by the dead `غ ض ب:B002/m01`; blood left without vengeance `ض ل ل:B003/m02`; indemnity in place of retaliation `غ ي ر:B002/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:7 `غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ ... ٱلضَّآلِّينَ` (`غ ي ر`, `غ ض ب`, `ض ل ل`)
- Synthesis: Injury activates anger, death or irreversible loss introduces grief, and retaliation offers one outcome. Indemnity supplies an alternate endpoint in which compensation replaces vengeance and prevents blood from remaining without redress.

#### Subchannel C. Rout and Collective Dispersal
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A group under pressure loses formation, turns away, and scatters along divergent routes.
- Active motifs: defeat and dispersal `ن ع م:B008/m01`; scattered groups and routes `ع ب د:B010/m01`; loss from a holder `ض ل ل:B003/m01`; mutual confrontation `ق و م:B014/m01`; hunters setting out in pursuit `س م و:B006/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:1 `بِسْمِ` (`س م و`); 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ ... ٱلضَّآلِّينَ` (`ن ع م`, `ض ل ل`)
- Synthesis: Confrontation supplies pressure, pursuit supplies direction, defeat breaks cohesion, and divergent routes express the spatial result. Loss describes the same event from the perspective of the former group.

#### Subchannel D. Hardness, Shielding, and the Cutting Edge
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A defender combines bodily strength with hard natural or worked material to resist a penetrating blade.
- Active motifs: hard folded hide used as a shield `غ ض ب:B008/m01`; cutting and penetrating sword `ص ر ط:B003/m01`; hard layered rock `غ ض ب:B004/m01`; bodily strength and solidity `ع ب د:B007/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:6 and 1:7 `ٱلصِّرَٰطَ` / `صِرَٰطَ` (`ص ر ط`); 1:7 `ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ` (`غ ض ب`)
- Synthesis: The sword supplies penetrating force, the shield supplies a worked resistant surface, rock supplies the material analogy for hardness, and bodily solidity supplies the agent capable of holding the defense.

## Standalone Subchannels

### S1. The Divinatory Arrow Vessel
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: A leather container gathers and preserves a set of lot or gaming arrows as one portable object assembly.
- Active motifs: leather receptacle `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; gathered lot-arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`
- Ayah anchors: 1:2 `رَبِّ` (`ر ب ب`)
- Synthesis: The receptacle supplies the enclosing component and the arrows supply its ordered contents. Their shared branch resolves into a complete container-and-tool scene distinct from weaponry or ordinary storage.

secondaryMaterial.text:
1. Pastoral kümenin (`ر ب ب B014`, `ع و ن B006`, `ن ع م B005`, `ض ل ل B005`) yüksek mekanik gücü, Fâtiha'nın kültürel-semiyotik arka planını ne ölçüde açıklar; ne noktada yalnız kök ağının yoğun eşleşmesine dönüşür?
2. `الْعَالَمِينَ` için açılan ekolojik sistemde su, bitki ve habitat dallarının sınırı nasıl korunmalıdır? Sistem düzeyi okuma güçlü görünürken belirli nesnelerin gloss gibi okunması engellenmelidir.
3. Borç-hesap modeli (`د ي ن B003`, `ق و م B015`) adaletin kesinliğini iyi açıklar; fakat rahmetin hesabı dönüştüren rolü aynı ağda nasıl temsil edilmelidir?
4. `الْمَغْضُوبِ`in edilgen, `الضَّالِّينَ`in etkin sıfat oluşu iki güzergâh arasındaki sorumluluk farkını ne ölçüde taşır? Rapor bu farkı korur, fakat kategorileri özdeşleştirmez.
5. `نَعْبُدُ`, `نَسْتَعِينُ` ve `اهْدِنَا`daki çoğul özne, korunan aidiyet modelini güçlendirir. Bunun topluluk, cemaat ve insanlık ölçeklerinden hangisinde daha verimli olduğu ayrıca sınanmalıdır.
6. `ر ب ب B015` ve `ي و م B005` sessiz (`S`) kalmıştır. Yeni bağlamsal kanıt olmadan bunların yükseltilmemesi, hatırlama-öncelikli yöntemin aşırı genişlemeye karşı önemli sınırıdır.
